cards.claim: Muon's convergence behavior differs systematically with and without Nesterov momentum
cards.conditions: Four practical settings analyzed theoretically; general neural network training
cards.effect: Convergence proof structure changes; qualitative behavior prediction enabled
cards.quote: We provide convergence proofs for Muon across four practical settings, systematically examining its behavior with and without the inclusion of Nesterov momentum and weight decay.

cards.claim: Weight decay on Muon interacts critically with learning rate and controls gradient/parameter boundedness
cards.conditions: Any neural network training; eliminates need for bounded-gradient assumption
cards.effect: Addition of weight decay ensures almost-sure boundedness of parameter and gradient norms; interplay between λ (weight decay) and lr becomes predictable
cards.quote: We then demonstrate that the addition of weight decay ensures almost-sure boundedness of the parameter and gradient norms -- without relying on the commonly imposed bounded-gradient assumption -- and clarify the interplay between the weight decay coefficient and the learning rate.

cards.claim: Muon's critical batch size (batch size minimizing SFO complexity) depends qualitatively on momentum β and weight decay λ hyperparameters
cards.conditions: Batch size optimization for Muon; depends on problem-dependent unobservable quantities (gradient variance, target precision, effective rank)
cards.effect: Batch size scaling is governed by momentum and weight decay settings; cannot predict absolute critical batch size but can predict relative scaling
cards.evidence: Lower bound derivation on critical batch size; formula shows hyperparameter dependence
cards.quote: it reveals how the hyperparameters $β$ (momentum) and $λ$ (weight decay) govern the qualitative scaling of this value.

cards.claim: Hyperparameter-dependent predictions (momentum, weight decay, batch size interactions) are validated across image classification and language modeling
cards.conditions: Image classification and language modeling workloads
cards.effect: Theoretical predictions confirm empirical behavior across diverse domains
cards.quote: Our experiments validate these hyperparameter-dependent predictions across workloads including image classification and language modeling.
